headline: Arsenal's Eberechi Eze to perform Cristiano Ronaldo-inspired celebration after loss to IShowSpeed
description: Eberechi Eze's next goal celebration has been determined by YouTuber IShowSpeed after the Arsenal forward was beaten by the influencer in an EA Sports FC battle.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool's Wirtz to Bayern Munich?
description: Florian Wirtz could end up returning to the Bundesliga, as Bayern Munich are keeping a close eye on his situation at Liverpool. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: 'Frustrated' Pierre Sage: Crystal Palace 'really far off' expectations in Lyon defeat
description: Pierre Sage said Crystal Palace were "really far off" his expectations after suffering a 3-2 Europa League defeat away to his former side Lyon.

headline: Man United's Martínez issues apology for post-match outburst after meeting
description: Lisandro Martínez has issued a formal apology after criticising Manchester United's board following the 2-0 defeat to Atlético Madrid.

headline: Moisés Caicedo determined to repay faith shown by Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso
description: Moisés Caicedo is determined to repay the faith shown in him by Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso and become more of a leader on the pitch.
